caption:
ASEAN's top official is in Pakistan, the first such visit in over two decades! 🤝
According to Arab News, ASEAN Secretary-General Kao Kim Hourn is visiting Pakistan from November 18 to 20 at the invitation of Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar, Pakistan's foreign ministry said on Wednesday. It is the first high-level visit from the ASEAN Secretariat to Pakistan in over two decades. Talks are expected to focus on trade, connectivity, investment and regional cooperation, and Hourn will call on Pakistan's leadership. Pakistan has been an ASEAN Sectoral Dialogue Partner since 1993.
